name: Single Flower Drops
materials: Enamel flower charms, gold-tone metal, gold french hooks
story:
One flower on one hook. I lay the charms out on the black felt in every color I have, red daisies, green blossoms, violet petals with a yellow heart, and let the pair choose itself.

They are the smallest thing I make and the easiest to wear. A little color at the ear, nothing more.
adBody: A single enamel flower charm on a gold french hook, in red, green, violet, pink, and more.
socialCaption: The single drops, laid out on the felt. Pick a color; each pair is one small flower on a gold hook.
altText: A young woman with curly dark hair in a ponytail, smiling, wearing a small red enamel daisy earring on a gold hook.

name: Flower & Leaf Cluster Drops
materials: Enamel blossoms and leaves, gold-tone links, gold kidney hooks
story:
These grow downward like a stem. A pale blossom at the top, a green enamel leaf, then a blue daisy at the end of the line. I link them one at a time with the pliers until the drop hangs straight.

They move when you turn your head, which is the whole point.
adBody: Blossom, leaf, and daisy linked into one gold drop that moves when you do.
socialCaption: Cluster drops: white blossom, green leaf, blue daisy, linked by hand on a gold kidney hook.
altText: A young woman with long straight dark hair in a pale blue shirt, in profile, wearing a drop earring of white blossoms, green leaves, and blue daisies.

name: Flower Charm Hoops
materials: Gold-tone wire hoops, interchangeable enamel flower charms
story:
Thin gold hoops, and a handful of flower charms that slide on and off. Pink blossom today, a yellow one tomorrow, a violet four-petal flower or a green daisy when the mood changes.

One pair of hoops, a different flower whenever you like. These are the ones people ask about.
adBody: Gold hoops with swappable enamel flower charms in pink, yellow, violet, and green.
socialCaption: Flower charm hoops: one pair of gold hoops, and the charms change. Pink, yellow, violet, green, pick one.
altText: A young woman with a blonde braid in a lilac sweater, smiling, wearing a thin gold hoop earring with a single pink enamel blossom charm.

name: Swap Hoops
materials: Gold-tone wire hoops, fluted melon beads with gold stripes
story:
The hoop opens and the bead slides off, so one pair of hoops can be orange today and sky blue tomorrow. I keep the beads in a row on the felt: orange, hot pink, lime, purple, pink, sky blue, green, red, cream.

Start with one color or take the whole set.
adHeadline: Change the bead, change the day
adBody: Gold hoops with swappable fluted beads, in sets of 1, 3, 5, or 10 colors.
socialCaption: Swap hoops with nine bead colors waiting. The five-color set is the one most people pick.
altText: A young woman with long dark hair in an ivory camisole, in profile, wearing a thin gold hoop threaded with a orange round bead with gold stripes.

name: Pumpkin Bead Drops
materials: Fluted melon beads with gold stripes, gold filigree caps, gold french hooks
story:
A round fluted bead between two gold filigree caps, so it hangs like a small lantern. I make them in green, red, orange, and cream, and every bead has its own gold lines running top to bottom.

The orange ones always go first in the fall.
adHeadline: A small lantern at the ear
adBody: A fluted bead capped in gold filigree, in green, red, orange, or cream.
socialCaption: Pumpkin bead drops in green, red, orange, and cream. Gold caps top and bottom, gold hook.
altText: A young woman with long braids in an olive turtleneck, in profile against a mustard wall, wearing a orange fluted bead earring with gold caps.

name: Tibetan Bead Drops
materials: Tibetan-style beads with turquoise and coral inlay, gold-tone wire
story:
The beads are the heavy, detailed kind: dark centers wrapped in twisted gold wire, set with turquoise and coral. I wire-wrap each one into a loop by hand so it hangs cleanly from the hook.

One is all blue-green stones in a gold cage. One has red and turquoise dots between gold swirls. Both feel old in the hand.
adBody: Inlaid Tibetan-style beads, wire-wrapped by hand into a single drop.
socialCaption: Tibetan bead drops, wrapped this week. Turquoise, coral, and a lot of twisted gold.
altText: A young woman with a dark braid in a maroon top, in profile against a stone wall, wearing a drop earring of a gold bead set with turquoise stones.

name: Throat Blossom
materials: Pink enamel, fine gold chain, a tiny clear stone
story:
The clasp was already on when I lifted it from the bench. A fine gold chain, and the blossom rests at the hollow of the throat. Pink enamel, gold along every petal, a tiny stone at the heart.

It is light on purpose. One flower, close to the skin, so an ordinary day has a single bright thing at the collarbone.
adBody: A pink enamel blossom on a fine gold chain, worn close to the skin.
socialCaption: The pendant, worn. One blossom, gold at the edge, sitting at the hollow of the throat.
altText: A young woman in a cream silk blouse wearing a pink enamel blossom pendant on a fine gold chain.

name: First Blossom
materials: Pink enamel, gold-tone metal, a tiny clear stone
story:
They were still loose on the white bench when the morning light found them. Three pink blossoms, each petal edged in gold. Two hold a tiny clear stone at the heart. One already wears its clasp, ready for a chain. At the edge of the table, a pale daisy the color of the inside of a shell.

I make them small on purpose. A flower you can close your hand around, then wear at the throat on an ordinary Tuesday, so the day has one bright thing in it.
adBody: Pink enamel, gold at every edge, and a pale daisy waiting beside them.
socialCaption: On the bench this morning: three pink blossoms and a pale daisy. One clasp is already on.
altText: A young woman in a cream silk blouse wearing a small pink enamel blossom earring edged in gold.

name: River Link
story: I hammered each link until the gold went matte, then hung a stone I picked up still warm from the bank. It sits low, a small weight you notice when you turn your head.
adBody: Hammered gold and one river stone, made to sit against the collarbone.
socialCaption: New on the bench: a hammered gold chain and a grey river stone. The links are uneven on purpose.
altText: A young woman with long black hair in an ivory linen top, wearing a hammered gold chain with a grey river-stone pendant, against a sage-green wall.

name: Two Clays
materials: Terracotta clay, cream clay, brass hooks
story: The top is the color of a brick after rain. The bottom is the cream clay I keep for quiet shapes. I left the surface a little dry so it catches light like plaster.
adBody: Two clay shapes on a brass hook, pressed by hand and left unglazed.
socialCaption: Unglazed clay earrings in terracotta and cream, with brass hooks. Light enough to forget, until someone asks.
altText: A young woman with a short natural afro, in profile, wearing a terracotta and cream clay earring on a brass hook.

name: Moss Setting
story: The band is silver I hammered until the marks stayed. The stone is a rough green, set in a bezel that follows its edges instead of forcing a circle.
adBody: A hammered silver ring holding one irregular green stone.
socialCaption: This ring keeps the stone's uneven edge. Silver, hammered, and a green that looks wet in window light.
altText: A young woman with a black bob in a charcoal sweater, holding up her hand to show a hammered silver ring with a rough green stone.

name: Three Turns
materials: Ochre, cream, and charcoal linen thread
story: I wound three bands of linen thread until the stack held its own shape. Ochre, cream, charcoal. They sit together like a small landscape on the wrist.
adBody: Three linen cuffs in ochre, cream, and charcoal, wrapped by hand.
socialCaption: Three thread cuffs, stacked. The colors are ochre, cream, and charcoal, wound until the fiber shows.
altText: A young woman with wavy copper-red hair in a rust linen shirt, her hand on her shoulder, wearing three stacked ochre, cream, and charcoal thread bangles.
